chapter.title: The Receipts
chapter.subtitle: Same girl. Two orders. A very different payer.
chapter.description: Same girl. Two orders. A very different payer. Watch the film, work the shift, solve the House puzzle, and win a fade against the red and blue crews.

tips: Use the House server after an ally is Burned or Frozen in the same district.
Do not pile every threat into the district Blue is protecting.
Holding two districts is enough; keep 1 Motion for the third star.
Round 1: Squabble House server joins your hand. Round 2: Squabble House cook joins your hand. These are temporary copies for this battle; pay their normal Motion costs to play them.

scenes.speaker: tek-KEN
scenes.text: Same girl. Two orders. Both on his tab.

scenes.speaker: Blue
scenes.text: I thought that was a hospitality program.

scenes.speaker: tek-KEN
scenes.text: The program is called paying. Let me sort the line items before somebody invents a discount.

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.text: Check every total. Then get Blue off the counter.

scenes.speaker: tek-KEN
scenes.text: Food, plus extras, minus discount. No mystery tax. Lowest final charge first.

scenes.speaker: Blue
scenes.text: Put mine under emotional support breakfast.

puzzle.title: Sort the Damage
puzzle.instruction: tek-KEN needs the receipt lines from smallest final charge to largest. Final charge = food + extras − discount. Use the amounts printed on each receipt. No tax or tip is added. All five final charges are different.
hints: Calculate each total before comparing them. A bigger printed food price can have a smaller final charge.
The final charges are $4, $6, $7, $9, $11. Blue’s $7 plate comes before Red’s $9 plate.
puzzle.solvedText: $37 in actual orders. Blue’s plate and Red’s plate share Red OG’s account number. The food was real; the romance story remains unverified.
puzzle.skipText: Let the crew explain the solution. The next fade still has to be won to earn its reward.
